name: Andrew Bushell
bio: Andrew Bushell is a Canadian actor and improvisor based in Toronto, Ontario. He is originally from Alberta.

credits.title: Limbo
credits.overview: Unwilling to process a near-fatal car accident, an overworked director arrives late to the set of his horror film to find that most of the crew has left. Determined to complete the film, he and the remaining crew find out that his trauma from the accident refuses to let him go that easily.

credits.title: Uncomfy
credits.overview: A woman in a comfortable, heteronormative relationship as she reaches out to an escort to explore her queer side in a quest to answer the age-old question, "Am I missing out on something?"

credits.title: The Perfect Christmas Date
credits.overview: Marie accidentally swaps diaries with a stranger at speed dating. As Christmas approaches, the holiday magic helps her find the right diary, and the right man, to make her Christmas season truly unforgettable.

credits.title: The Royal Nannies
credits.overview: Carter is tasked with serving as both nanny and protector to Princess Isabella while the King and Queen are away on a trade mission. Under the guardianship of her uncle, Prince Theo, the family is faced with unexpected challenges, and as Carter and Theo grow closer, she finds herself torn between love and duty.

credits.title: Friends Like Us
credits.overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

credits.title: Serious Buyers Only
credits.overview: A middle class couple and a disgraced heiress come head to head when both parties seek ownership of an empty plot of land. Calder, the cunning broker, pits the two against each other to further his own agenda.

credits.title: Dinner with Friends
credits.overview: Shot in 9 days on a budget of $100k, Dinner with Friends follows eight friends trying to hold on to their group as they get older and life gets complicated. credits.title: A Country Encore
credits.overview: A corporate jingle writer is on the verge of abandoning her songwriting dreams for good when she mistakenly hands over an old love song to the man who broke her heart, a famous country singer is looking for his next hit.

credits.title: Wynonna Earp: Vengeance
credits.overview: Wynonna Earp is coming home to battle her greatest foe yet: a psychotic seductress hellbent on revenge against her... and everyone she loves.

credits.title: Close to You
credits.overview: A trans man returns to his hometown for the first time in years. On his journey, he confronts his relationship with his family, reunites with a first love, and discovers a newfound confidence in himself.

credits.overview: High school sweethearts who meet again at their reunion and are visited by three ghosts that make them reconsider why they ever broke up.

credits.overview: Esteemed astrophysicist Kat, scheduled for her first trip into space but sidelined due to an accident, meets a new man at the local planetarium. Together, they must work hard to open a new exhibit by Christmas.

credits.overview: Lauren supported her husband Peter get his career going. This means her dream of opening an art gallery has been put on the back burner. Soon, she becomes so resentful that it tears their marriage apart.

credits.title: Record Breaking Christmas
credits.overview: Working for the World Record Bureau, Leah Hoffman is forced to travel to a small town just before Christmas to investigate its plans to break multiple holiday world records. While there, she falls for the town’s doctor, Devan Bancroft.

credits.title: All I Didn't Want for Christmas
credits.overview: Emily Harris is not doing great. In a desperate attempt to improve her life and make this Christmas not totally suck, Emily writes a letter to Santa. Fortunately, and unfortunately, her wine-soaked wishes start coming true.

credits.overview: A rookie drag queen, reeling from a break-up, escapes to the country, where he finds his grandmother in steep decline yet desperate to avoid the local nursing home.

credits.title: Falling in Love at Christmas
credits.overview: Miranda and Paul, two business rivals who playfully despise each other, work together on a holiday gift-giving app, and unexpected feelings develop for one another.

credits.title: Love at Sky Gardens
credits.overview: When Deirdre accidentally spills coffee on regular customer and event planner, Deirdre offers to help him get back on track by lending her rooftop garden design services for his boss's next big event.

credits.title: Romance in the Wilds
credits.overview: Deep in the Rocky Mountains, lightning strikes a mining site, sparking a deadly wildfire and igniting an unexpected romance between a forest ranger and a geologist as they race to escape the flames.

credits.title: Murder on Maple Drive
credits.overview: In an effort to "keep up with the Joneses", a couple stretches their finances to purchase a home in an upper-class neighborhood. credits.title: Heart of the Holidays
credits.overview: After her life in New York unexpectedly falls apart, powerhouse stockbroker Sam Wallace returns to her small town for the holidays and reconnects with her high school sweetheart who helps reignite her humanitarian spirit just in time to help their community on Christmas.

credits.title: Dashing Home for Christmas
credits.overview: Holiday traveling mishaps force a successful business consultant to find a way home with help from a stranger.

credits.title: Love by Accident
credits.overview: While on a road trip to spread her godfather's ashes, Daphne and her ill godmother Fran get into an accident forcing them to make an unexpected stop. Wanting to keep Fran off the road, Daphne enlists Matthew, their mechanic, to be her fake boyfriend. But soon their fake relationship isn't so fake after all.

credits.title: Twinkle All the Way
credits.overview: To pull off a spectacular Christmas-themed wedding, a wedding planner joins forces with the co-owner of a family-run Christmas decoration and house-lighting company.

credits.title: Christmas Catch
credits.overview: Detective Mackenzie Bennett is hot on the trail of Carson, a suspected diamond thief, and goes undercover to catch him in the act. While undercover, Mack not only falls for Carson, but begins to suspect that he's been framed. Are feelings clouding Mack's judgment or are they focusing on the wrong suspect?

credits.title: Jesse
credits.overview: After her parents are killed in a car accident, twenty-two year old Kelly Turner finds herself in the overwhelming position of being the sole caregiver for her older brother Jesse who has autism.
